subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Modern Action Film
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Modern Action Film.

hook.text: Die Hard put an ordinary cop in an extraordinary situation — and redefined action.

buildup.text: Before 1988, action heroes were invincible. John McClane bled, limped, and complained.

discovery.text: Vulnerability made audiences care more than muscles ever could.

twist.text: The 'Die Hard on a...' formula was copied so often it became a Hollywood joke.

climax.text: Modern action cinema still chases that mix of tension, humor, and human stakes.

punchline.text: The best action hero was barefoot and scared.

quiz.question: What made Die Hard's hero different from earlier action stars?
